T: Scrooge is tight. The gravy isn't.
D: A miserly money lender is visited by three spirits on Christmas Eve, with a few Muppets along for the ride.
P: Serve the mains when Scrooge sends for the prize turkey.
S: Aged cheddar and brown pickle on buttered white bread, crusts off, cut in quarters
Thick white bread with sharp cheddar and sweet brown pickle, cut into little party triangles.
the spirit surrounded by a mountain of food

A towering board of roast chestnuts, clementines, grapes, Stilton, walnuts, honey-glazed ham and gingerbread, piled high like the spirit's feast. Cut a cross in 300g chestnuts and roast at 200C for 25 minutes, then peel while warm. Toss 100g walnuts with 1 tbsp honey and bake 8 minutes. Pile everything onto a big board: the chestnuts and walnuts, 6 clementines, 1 bunch grapes, a 200g wedge of Stilton, 200g sliced honey ham, 8 gingerbread biscuits and a packet of oat crackers.
Cheddar and Red Leicester wedges with pickled onions and apple chutney
Mature cheddar and Red Leicester cut into wedges, with pickled onions, apple chutney and oatcakes, laid out on a little wooden board.
M: The prize turkey from the shop window
the big turkey Scrooge buys for the Cratchits

Butter-basted roast turkey with thyme and lemon, chestnut stuffing, roast potatoes, Brussels sprouts with bacon and plenty of gravy for the whole table. Rub a 4kg turkey with 80g butter mashed with thyme and lemon zest under the skin. Roast at 170C for 2 hours 15 minutes until the breast reaches 65C, then rest under foil 45 minutes. Bake 150g breadcrumbs with 100g chopped cooked chestnuts, 1 onion, 1 egg and 150ml stock for 30 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes. Fry 400g halved sprouts with 100g bacon. Make gravy with 300ml stock.
Crisp roast goose legs, goose fat potatoes, braised red cabbage with apple
Goose legs salted overnight, roasted at 170C for 2 hours until crisp, potatoes roasted in the goose fat, with braised red cabbage and apple sauce.
W: Steamed fruit pudding soaked in orange juice and tea, carried in steaming

Rich dried fruit pudding soaked in orange juice and cold tea, steamed for hours, served hot with a jug of warm vanilla custard. Soak 500g mixed dried fruit in 150ml orange juice and 50ml cold black tea overnight. Mix with 125g soft butter, 125g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 100g breadcrumbs, 75g plain flour, 2 tsp mixed spice and the zest of 1 orange. Spoon into a greased 1.2L basin, cover tightly with baking paper and foil, and steam for 4 hours, topping up the water. Turn out and serve hot with 600ml warm custard.
K: Warm grape and cranberry juice with roasted orange, cinnamon and star anise

Red grape and cranberry juice warmed gently with clove-studded roasted oranges, cinnamon and a little sugar, ladled steaming into cups. Stud 2 oranges with cloves and roast at 180C for 30 minutes. Put 750ml red grape juice and 500ml cranberry juice in a saucepan with the oranges, 2 cinnamon sticks, 2 star anise and 1 tbsp brown sugar. Warm gently for 20 minutes without boiling. Ladle into 4 cups with a slice of the roasted orange in each.

steps.text: Butter the bread.
Spread half the slices with pickle, cover with thinly sliced cheddar and top with the other slices.
Trim the crusts and cut each into 4 triangles.
Take the cheeses out of the fridge an hour ahead.
Cut the vintage cheddar and Red Leicester into wedges and arrange on a wooden board with pickled onions, a bowl of chutney and a stack of oatcakes.
Salt the goose legs and leave overnight in the fridge.
Roast at 170C until crisp, pouring off the fat as it renders.
Halve the potatoes and roast in the goose fat at 200C.
Shred the cabbage and slice the apples, then braise together with the vinegar.
Braise gently until soft.

steps.text: Fry the onion and mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry, then cool and mix with the chestnuts, walnuts, lentils, breadcrumbs, eggs and half the salt.
Press into a lined loaf tin and bake at 180C until firm and browned.
Halve the potatoes, toss in the remaining oil and salt and roast at 200C alongside the roast for 45 minutes.
Shred the cabbage and slice the apples, then braise together with the vinegar and a splash of water for 45 minutes until soft.
Rest the roast for 10 minutes, then turn out and slice.
